title: Motor Dealers Stockpiling Motorcycle COEs to Resell at Higher Price
what_it_is: Motor Dealers Stockpiling Motorcycle COEs to Resell at Higher Price

sections.label: Motorcycle COE stockpiling data
sections.summary: Data shows no irregular COE stockpiling by dealers, except briefly after tiered ARF for motorcycles, and those TCOEs are used up or expired.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Our data does not reveal any irregular stockpiling of COEs, or the use of the stockpile, by the dealers, with the exception of the period shortly after the tiered Additional Registration Fee (ARF) for motorcycles was introduced.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: In that instance, dealers might have kept some of the TCOEs garnered before the announcement of tiered ARF to register more expensive motorcycles.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: The TCOEs have all been used up or expired.

sections.label: Motorcycle COE premiums and TCOE validity
sections.summary: Category D TCOE premiums rose to about $8,081 in March 2017, fell to about $3,500 in August 2017, and were $8,001 in January 2018.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: Since the implementation of the tiered ARF for motorcycles, the category TCOE quota premiums have increased from around $6,000 to all-time high of about $8,081 in the second bidding exercise of March 2017, before dropping to about $3,500 in August 2017.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: So, Members can see that the COE premium actually fluctuates, depending on factors, such as demand and supply.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: However, we do notice that the Category D TCOE premium was at $8,001 for the second bidding exercise of January 2018 and we will be watching the trend closely.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: The reason why we are not doing so is because if we do shorten the validity period of the Cat D TCOEs, it basically reduces the time available for the dealers or individuals to secure a vehicle before their TCOEs expires, and dealers may have to maintain a large inventory of vehicles to meet the shorter validity period.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: With regard to the Member's question on the deposit, the reason why it is tagged at $200 is because the quota premium for motorcycles is much lower than that of normal cars.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: However, like I have mentioned, we do monitor all these very closely and, if necessary, we may look into changing the COE policies.
